project_description: A fullstack task management CRUD application using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Jinja2.

files.description: List of project dependencies: fastapi, uvicorn, sqlalchemy, pydantic, pydantic-settings, jinja2, python-multipart, alembic
Application configuration using Pydantic Settings for database URL and environment variables.
SQLAlchemy engine and session configuration for SQLite.
SQLAlchemy ORM model for Task with fields: id, title, description, completed, created_at.
Pydantic schemas (DTOs) for Task: TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and TaskResponse.
Data access layer implementing CRUD operations for the Task model using SQLAlchemy session.
Service layer containing business logic, coordinating between repository and schemas.
FastAPI router defining REST endpoints (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for tasks.
Jinja2 template for the main task dashboard UI.
CSS file for responsive and clean UI design.
Application entry point: initializes FastAPI, mounts static files, includes routers, and sets up templates.
Alembic configuration file for database migrations.
Pytest suite for testing API endpoints using httpx.
Dockerfile for containerizing the FastAPI application.
